name: Marine Mammals
meaning: Whales, dolphins, seals, manatees and dugongs
description: Warm-blooded vertebrates that live in the sea: whales and dolphins, seals and sea lions, manatees and dugongs.
descriptionBn: সাগরে বসবাসকারী উষ্ণ-রক্তের মেরুদণ্ডী প্রাণী: তিমি, ডলফিন, সিল, ম্যানাটি ও ডুগং।

references.title: Required educational classification (Marine Life Module specification)

name: Marine Reptiles
meaning: Sea turtles, sea snakes and other ocean-going reptiles
description: Reptiles that live in the sea: sea turtles, sea snakes and saltwater crocodiles.
descriptionBn: সাগরে বসবাসকারী সরীসৃপ: সামুদ্রিক কচ্ছপ, সামুদ্রিক সাপ ও লোনা পানির কুমির।

references.title: Required educational classification (Marine Life Module specification)

name: Marine Birds
meaning: Penguins, albatrosses, petrels and other seabirds
description: Birds with a genuine marine ecological relationship: penguins, albatrosses, petrels, gannets and cormorants.
descriptionBn: সাগরের সঙ্গে প্রকৃত পরিবেশগত সম্পর্কযুক্ত পাখি: পেঙ্গুইন, অ্যালবাট্রস, পেট্রেল, গ্যানেট ও করমোরান্ট।

references.title: Required educational classification (Marine Life Module specification)

name: Marine Invertebrates
meaning: Sponges, jellyfish, corals, molluscs, crustaceans, sea stars and worms
description: Ocean animals without backbones: sponges, jellyfish, corals, molluscs, crustaceans, sea stars, urchins and marine worms.
descriptionBn: মেরুদণ্ডহীন সামুদ্রিক প্রাণী: স্পঞ্জ, জেলিফিশ, প্রবাল, শামুক-ঝিনুক, চিংড়ি-কাঁকড়া, তারা-মাছ ও সামুদ্রিক কৃমি।

taxonomyNotes: Only marine arthropods belong here; insects, spiders and freshwater species are out of scope.

meaning: Sea stars, urchins and sea cucumbers

description: Worm-like marine animals including acorn worms.

references.title: Required educational classification (Marine Life Module specification)

name: Physeteridae
description: Family of giant deep-diving toothed whales; the sperm whale is its largest living member.

characteristics.en: Huge square head with spermaceti organ
Single blowhole on the left side of the head
Deep-diving squid hunters using powerful echolocation

name: Dugongidae
description: Family of sirenians; the dugong is its only living member.

characteristics.en: Strictly marine herbivores feeding on seagrasses
Downturned bristled muzzle for bottom grazing

name: Phocidae
description: True (earless) seals, including harbour seals, grey seals and elephant seals.

characteristics.en: Hind flippers trail behind and cannot rotate forward

habitat: Coastal waters, haul-out shores and ice
distribution: Worldwide, mostly cold and temperate coasts

name: Dermochelyidae
description: Leathery-shelled sea turtles; the leatherback is its only living member.

characteristics.en: Leathery skin over a mosaic of small bones, no scutes

habitat: Open ocean and tropical nesting beaches
distribution: Global, all tropical to subpolar oceans

name: Elapidae
description: Venomous snakes with short fixed fangs, including cobras, kraits and the sea-snake subfamily Hydrophiinae.

characteristics.en: Short hollow fixed fangs delivering neurotoxic venom
Marine members with paddle tails and salt glands
Sea snakes fully viviparous at sea

name: Spheniscidae
description: Flightless Southern Hemisphere seabirds, including emperor and king penguins.

characteristics.en: Flightless with stiff flipper wings for underwater propulsion
Dense waterproof plumage over thick blubber
Colonial breeders, many on Antarctic ice

name: Diomedeidae
description: Great gliding tubenose seabirds of the Southern Ocean.

characteristics.en: Longest wings of any bird, locking for gliding
Tube nostrils on a large hooked bill

habitat: Open Southern Ocean and island colonies

name: Sulidae
description: Plunge-diving seabirds including gannets and boobies.

characteristics.en: Long pointed bills and dagger-shaped wings

habitat: Coastal and pelagic waters near colonies
modernTaxonomyNote: WoRMS places Sulidae in Pelecaniformes; IUCN/BirdLife assessments use Suliformes, retained here.

references.title: IUCN Red List taxonomy: Morus bassanus (Sulidae, Suliformes)

name: Fregatidae
description: Soaring kleptoparasitic tropical seabirds that cannot land on water.

characteristics.en: Largest wingspan-to-weight ratio of any bird
Deeply forked tail and hooked bill
Steals food from other seabirds in flight

distribution: Tropical Pacific, Indian and South Atlantic Oceans
modernTaxonomyNote: WoRMS places Fregatidae in Pelecaniformes; IUCN/BirdLife assessments use Suliformes, retained here.

references.title: IUCN Red List taxonomy: Fregata minor (Fregatidae, Suliformes)

name: Asteroidea
description: Sea stars (starfish); echinoderms with arms radiating from a central disk.

characteristics.en: Tube feet powered by a water-vascular system

habitat: Seafloors from intertidal to deep sea

name: Forcipulatida
description: Order of sea stars with pincer-like pedicellariae, including common starfishes.

name: Asteriidae
description: Family of forcipulate sea stars including the common starfish.

characteristics.en: Five broad arms with spiny upper surface

name: Semaeostomeae
description: Order of true jellyfishes including moon jellies.

name: Ulmaridae
description: Family of saucer-shaped jellyfishes including moon jellies.

characteristics.en: Saucer bell with four visible gonad rings
Short marginal tentacles and frilly oral arms

name: Anthozoa
description: Polyp-only cnidarians: sea anemones, corals and sea pens.
habitat: Seafloors from intertidal to deep sea
modernTaxonomyNote: WoRMS nests Hexacorallia as class under Anthozoa; Anthozoa retained here as the project class.

name: Actiniaria
description: Order of solitary flower-like cnidarian polyps.

name: Actiniidae
description: Family of sea anemones including beadlet anemones.

name: Nephropidae
description: Clawed lobsters including European and American lobsters.

characteristics.en: Massive unequal crusher and cutter claws
Muscular tail fan for escape swimming

name: Phocoenidae
description: Small blunt-headed toothed whales, including harbour porpoises.

name: Trichechidae
description: Manatees of Atlantic coasts and rivers.

name: Odobenidae
description: Tusked Arctic pinnipeds; single living species.

characteristics.en: Long ivory tusks in both sexes

habitat: Arctic sea ice and shallow shelves

name: Procellariidae
description: Gadfly petrels, shearwaters and giant petrels.

characteristics.en: Tube nostrils on a hooked bill

name: Phalacrocoracidae
description: Pursuit-diving coastal waterbirds.
habitat: Coasts, estuaries and large inland waters
modernTaxonomyNote: WoRMS places Phalacrocoracidae in Pelecaniformes; IUCN/BirdLife assessments use Suliformes, retained here.

references.title: IUCN Red List taxonomy: Phalacrocorax carbo (Phalacrocoracidae, Suliformes)

name: Nautilida
description: Externally shelled cephalopods.

name: Nautilidae
description: Chambered nautiluses of Indo-Pacific reef slopes.

name: Gastropoda
description: Largest mollusc class: snails, limpets, whelks and slugs.

characteristics.en: Usually a coiled or cap-like shell

name: Patellida
description: Cap-shelled grazing gastropods.

name: Patellidae
description: Conical intertidal grazing snails.

name: Pectinida
description: Swimming bivalves and allies.

name: Pectinidae
description: Fan-shelled swimming bivalves.

name: Echinidae
description: Family of globular grazing urchins.

name: Holothuriida
description: Order of sausage-shaped holothurians.

name: Holothuriidae
description: Family including sandfish and other tropical cucumbers.

name: Ophiuroidea
description: Snake-armed echinoderms distinct from starfish.

characteristics.en: No suckered tube feet for walking

name: Amphilepidida
description: Order of small brittle stars.

name: Ophiotrichidae
description: Family of spiny-armed suspension-feeding brittle stars.

name: Demospongiae
description: Most sponge diversity; siliceous spicules and spongin.

name: Suberitida
description: Order of massive and encrusting sponges.
modernTaxonomyNote: EPPO lists Halichondriidae under Halichondrida; WoRMS Suberitida retained here.

name: Halichondriidae
description: Friable encrusting sponges of coasts worldwide.

name: Tentaculata
description: Comb jellies bearing fishing tentacles.

name: Cydippida
description: Globular tentacled comb jellies.

name: Cydippidae
description: Family of small globular comb jellies.
modernTaxonomyNote: EPPO lists Pleurobrachia under Pleurobrachiidae; WoRMS Cydippidae retained here.

name: Polychaeta
description: Mostly marine segmented worms with parapodia.

name: Arenicolidae
description: Burrowing deposit-feeding worms of sandy shores.

characteristics.en: U/J burrows with blow hole and cast

modernTaxonomyNote: WoRMS leaves Arenicola order unassigned (some place in Capitellida); family attached directly under Polychaeta.

name: Enteropneusta
description: Burrowing hemichordates with proboscis, collar and gill-slit trunk.

name: Harrimaniidae
description: Family of small acorn worms including the evo-devo model Saccoglossus.
taxonomyNotes: WoRMS lists Saccoglossus order as incertae sedis; family attached directly under Enteropneusta.
